canonical_project: Cook Islands Government (CIG) Data Center colocation
owner: Office of the Prime Minister, Government of the Cook Islands (host operator not publicly disclosed)
notes: A-grade procurement: PPCI RFT Data Centre Colocation (tender=3374, published 2020-11-11, closed 2020-12-09) sought an ICT supplier to provide colocation for the CIG Data Center (category 81112000 Data Services; contact OPM Director of ICT, Avarua Rarotonga). B-grade delivery: Aiscorp press release states the government centralised network and data centre colocation was upgraded in December 2021 with the tender awarded to Aiscorp. Colocation host site not publicly disclosed (Rarotonga/Avarua most probable per methodology). Government-data-centre-colocation asset class; small-island grid, no public IT-load/MW evidence.
